column1: During the year the company invested a USD denominated Short Term Deposit with Lafarge Holcim
International Finance Ltd, a former related party by virtue of common shareholding and/or directorship.
The deposit attracted interest of 3-months USD SIFOR plus margin of 0.03% and was fixed quarterly in
advance. Interest earned from the deposit in the year amounted to Kes 58 million (2023: Kes 14million)
